question: ______ is found in association with rocks composed of calcium carbonates.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Limestone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rocks** made of **calcium carbonates or calcium and magnesium carbonates** are frequently found next to limestone. Most geological formation's sedimentary rocks include it.
 
• The primary raw ingredient for the cement industry, limestone is also necessary for the blast furnace to process iron ore.
 
• The majority of the carbonate rock in sedimentary rock, which makes **up 20% to 25%** of it, is limestone.
 
• The majority of the remaining carbonate rock is the closely related dolomite, which has a high concentration of the mineral dolomite, **CaMg(CO₃)₂**.
 
• Dolomite, limestone that has a considerable amount of dolomite (dolomitic limestone), and any other type of limestone that contains a significant amount of magnesium are all referred to as magnesia limestone, a defunct and poorly defined word. 
 
• Approximately 30% of the world's petroleum reservoirs are found in limestone rocks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The chemical element **gold** has the atomic number 79 and the symbol Au. This places it among the naturally occurring elements with higher atomic numbers.
 
• The chemical element** iron **has the atomic number 26 and the symbol Fe. It is a metal that is found in group 8 of the periodic table and the first transition series. 
 
• The atoms of diamonds are grouped in a crystal structure known as** diamond cubic**, and it is a solid form of the element carbon.
